verdict.rationale: Langfuse's own API docs list a Metrics API v2 for querying cost, latency, volume and score metrics, a CLI for coding agents, SDK-based API querying, and an MCP Server for AI tools that cannot run shell commands. A hands-on user confirms a trace/generation retrieval API exists, though it was slow for bulk scanning. missing for 10: detailed documentation of which trace/eval data the MCP server exposes, evidence that bulk trace retrieval performs well (one user found it 'brutally slow' and queried the DB directly), and independent corroboration of agent-driven debugging workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app

citations.quote: Query aggregate cost, usage, latency, volume, or score metrics | [Metrics API v2]
Connect an AI tool that cannot run shell commands | MCP Server
Work with Langfuse from a terminal or coding agent | CLI
Use the API from Python or JS/TS Query via SDKs
